source: Moved out of chat-service/questionnaire.js (RFP_FEDERAL_PPP) on 20 October 2026, word for word: AKLA's "Federal PPP RFP — Drafting Options Matrix" for Volume I (Tender Procedure) of the federal PPP standard. The rules that were functions (appliesWhen, auto, filter) are written as conditions: {"is": [question, option…]}, {"answered": question}, {"not": …}, {"all": […]}, {"any": […]}; auto is a list of {when, then}; hide is a list of {options, when} (the options not offered when the condition holds).
name: Federal PPP RFP — Volume I drafting decisions
closing: That completes the drafting decisions. What remains are the project's own facts — Agency name and address, the Transaction Advisor, key dates (issue, pre-bid meeting, bid submission, openings, award, signing), submission addresses and portal links, and the numeric thresholds (net worth, average annual revenue, Bid Security %, Performance Security %, bid validity, litigation threshold, Consortium ownership caps). Give them to me in the chat, or point me at the project documents that hold them, and I will fill each [●].

questions.title: PPP delivery modality
questions.question: Which PPP delivery modality will the Project use?
questions.location: Glossary "Project" definition ("delivered under PPP mode on a [●] basis"); General/Introduction ("engage a private party on a PPP basis to [design, finance, build, operate and transfer / [●]] the Project"); Bidding Forms T1 and F1 ("Re: [Design, finance, build, operate and transfer / [●]] of … Project")
questions.basis: Bracketed alternative in the RFP; modality menu per standard PPP taxonomy and ADB's Pakistan PPP Landscape note.

questions.title: Term structure of the concession
questions.question: How is the concession term to be structured?
questions.location: "Term" clause — construction period of [●] and operating period of [●]
questions.basis: Numeric placeholders in the RFP; alternatives per standard concession drafting.

options.label: Fixed term
options.hint: Fixed construction period + fixed operating period

options.label: Traffic/revenue-linked term
options.hint: Ends once a cumulative revenue/traffic target is reached — common for toll roads

questions.title: Qualified / non-Qualified Project
questions.question: Is this a Qualified Project under the P3A Act?
questions.location: "Government Support" section introduction; approval-chain references throughout
questions.basis: Section 2(v), P3A Act 2017.

options.label: Qualified Project
options.hint: Support required (VGF / Sovereign Guarantee / PDF) or so designated by the P3WP — the full P3WP → P3A Board → CDWP → ECNEC chain applies

options.label: Non-Qualified Project
options.hint: Procured solely under the PPRA Rules; no P3A approval chain

questions.title: Regulatory approval chain
questions.question: For a non-Qualified Project, what should happen to the "Regulatory Approvals and Compliance" approval chain?
questions.location: "Regulatory Approvals and Compliance" section; "Qualified Project Approval Chain"
questions.basis: Mandatory for Qualified Projects; removable with legal sign-off for a non-Qualified federal PPP procured solely under the PPRA Rules.

options.label: Delete the approval chain
options.hint: With legal sign-off — procured solely under the PPRA Rules

questions.title: Project Concept Proposal approval step
questions.question: Should the optional Project Concept Proposal approval step be kept in the approval chain?
questions.location: "Qualified Project Approval Chain", item (a): "[Project Concept Proposal (optional) approved by the P3WP…]"
questions.basis: Optional under section 13A(2)(a), P3A Act.

options.label: Include it
options.hint: Keep the Project Concept Proposal as a discrete approval step

options.label: Omit it
options.hint: Proceed directly to the Project Qualification Proposal

questions.title: Method of procurement
questions.question: Which method of procurement applies?
questions.location: "Tender Procedure" introductory clause
questions.basis: Rules 14 and 20, PPRA Rules 2004.

options.label: Open competitive bidding
options.hint: Rule 20, PPRA Rules — the RFP's default

options.label: Restricted / limited tendering
options.hint: Rule 14 exception — requires prior PPRA approval

options.label: Direct contracting
options.hint: Only for IFI transaction advisers under the 2023 Regulations — not for the main procurement

questions.title: Competitive bidding basis
questions.question: Is the tender national or international? (This sets the minimum notice period.)
questions.location: Indicative Schedule footnote ("not less than [thirty (30)] days … international competitive bidding … or not less than [fifteen (15)] days for a national competitive bidding"); Publication and Advertisement clause
questions.basis: Rule 13(1), PPRA Rules.

options.label: International competitive bidding
options.hint: Minimum 30 days' notice; publication may extend to international platforms via MOFA / SIFC / BOI

options.label: National, with international outreach
options.hint: Where foreign private parties are to be invited

questions.title: Bidding procedure
questions.question: Which bidding procedure will be used?
questions.location: Data Sheet item 6: "Bidding procedure [Single Stage Two Envelope / adopted [●]]"
questions.basis: Rules 36 and 37(a), PPRA Rules.

options.label: Single-stage two-envelope
options.hint: The firm's default for PPP concessions

questions.title: Bid submission mechanism
questions.question: How will bids be submitted?
questions.location: "Preparation of Bids" clause ("[simultaneously through [the PPRA/Agency e-procurement portal, where used] / by …]"); Data Sheet item 10
questions.basis: Rule 22, PPRA Rules; PPRA e-procurement regulations.

options.label: e-Procurement platform
options.hint: Cite the PPRA e-procurement regulation relied on

options.label: Electronic, with physical originals as backup

questions.title: Revenue / compensation structure
questions.question: How will the Concessionaire be paid?
questions.location: "Compensation of Concessionaire" clause ("structured on a [revenue/availability-payment/hybrid] model … [levy and collect Revenues from users / receive availability payments from the Agency / [●]]")
questions.basis: Regulation 9(2)(b), Process Flow Regulations 2021.

options.label: Availability payments
options.hint: Paid by the Agency regardless of usage

options.label: Shadow toll
options.hint: Agency pays per user/vehicle; users pay nothing

options.label: Government payment for use / capacity charge

questions.title: Revenue-sharing mechanism
questions.question: Should the Government share in revenue above a threshold?
questions.location: "Compensation of Concessionaire" clause ("thresholds and sharing ratios to be inserted as placeholders: [●]% / [●]%")
questions.basis: Placeholder in the RFP; standard concession revenue-share drafting.

options.label: Single threshold
options.hint: Revenue above a target shared at a fixed ratio

options.label: Minimum guaranteed return with upside sharing

questions.title: Tariff / payment escalation
questions.question: How should the tariff or payments escalate over the term?
questions.location: Terms of Reference ("escalation percentages … O&M cost caps")
questions.basis: Flagged as project-specific in the standard's AKLA comments.

questions.title: Federal Government support
questions.question: Which forms of Federal Government support are on offer? Select all that apply.
questions.location: "Government Support" clause, items (a)–(d)
questions.basis: Sections 11 and 12, P3A Act; Chapter IV, Federal PPP Policy 2023–2028.

options.label: Government equity contribution
options.hint: e.g. Class B equity in the SPV

questions.title: Primary source of financing
questions.question: How will the Project be financed?
questions.location: "Financing" clause ("financed through a combination of [equity, [Federal Government support, if applicable,] and commercial debt]")
questions.basis: Bracketed alternative in the RFP.

options.label: Commercial debt only
options.hint: No fresh sponsor equity — e.g. leveraged brownfield refinancing

options.label: Sponsor equity + Government support
options.hint: Class B equity / sub-debt / MRG; little or no commercial debt

options.label: No external financing
options.hint: Government-funded; the private party contributes services only

questions.title: Financing mix
questions.question: What is the composition of the blended financing?
questions.location: "Financing" clause ("[equity, [Federal Government support, if applicable,] and commercial debt]")
questions.basis: Bracketed alternative in the RFP.

questions.title: Currency of bid and payment
questions.question: Which currencies may the bid and payments be in?
questions.location: "Currencies of Bid and Payment" clause ("state all monetary amounts in Pakistani Rupees (PKR), unless the Data Sheet permits a different currency …")
questions.basis: Conditional wording in the RFP.

options.label: PKR, with foreign currency for specified line items
options.hint: e.g. imported plant, foreign debt service

options.label: Dual-currency bid
options.hint: PKR + one nominated foreign currency (e.g. USD) for the whole Financial Proposal

questions.title: Benchmark interest rate
questions.question: What benchmark should the financial model's debt be priced on?
questions.location: Financial Proposal / Terms of Reference ("KIBOR/benchmark rate … workings")
questions.basis: Flagged as project-specific in the standard's AKLA comments.

questions.title: Bidder structure
questions.question: Who may bid?
questions.location: "Consortium / Consortium Member" glossary entries; Eligibility Criteria
questions.basis: Structure in the RFP; carve-out flagged in the standard's AKLA comments.

options.label: Consortia permitted
options.hint: Lead Member + Members, with a cap on the number of Members

options.label: Consortia, with separate EPC Contractor qualification

questions.title: EPC / delivery contractor
questions.question: Is a separate EPC or delivery contractor required?
questions.location: Annexure A: "Eligibility Criteria for EPC Contractor / Delivery Partner Only (where the delivery model contemplates a separate EPC/delivery contractor)"
questions.basis: Conditional bracket in Annexure A.

options.label: Required
options.hint: Nominated within the Consortium, with its own eligibility criteria

options.label: Not required
options.hint: The Bidder / Lead Member self-performs construction

questions.title: Technical evaluation category
questions.question: How should the 60-mark capability category in the technical evaluation be labelled?
questions.location: Annexure B, Part 1 marking table: "B) [Construction/Delivery] Capability — [60] marks"
questions.basis: Bracketed alternative in the RFP.

options.label: Delivery Capability
options.hint: Service or non-construction PPPs — digital, social infrastructure

questions.title: Net worth / average annual revenue basis
questions.question: Should the financial eligibility test use construction revenue or sector revenue?
questions.location: "Net Worth and Average Annual [Construction/Sector] Revenue of not less than PKR [●]"
questions.basis: Bracketed alternative in the RFP.

questions.title: Technical qualification scoring
questions.question: How should bidders be technically qualified?
questions.location: "In order to be technically qualified, the Bidder must: (i) score at least [●]% in each category …; (ii) achieve an overall score of not less than [●] …"
questions.basis: Bracketed thresholds in the RFP.

options.label: Minimum per category + minimum overall score
Combined technical + financial score at a single stage

questions.title: Bid award criterion
questions.question: On what basis is the winning bid chosen?
questions.location: Financial Evaluation Criteria (Annexure B, Part 2); Bidding Form F2
questions.basis: Flagged in the standard's AKLA comments.

options.label: Highest NPV of payments to Government

questions.title: Bid security
questions.question: What form of bid security is required?
questions.location: "Bid Security" clause
questions.basis: Rule 25 and its proviso, PPRA Rules.

options.label: Unconditional bank guarantee
options.hint: Up to 5% of estimated Project value — Rule 25

options.label: Bid-securing declaration
options.hint: No bank guarantee — proviso to Rule 25

questions.title: Financing evidence at bid stage (Form F4)
questions.question: Should bidders provide evidence of financing (an indicative term sheet or letter of intent) with their bid?
questions.location: Bidding Form F4 — Indicative Term Sheet / Letter of Intent
questions.basis: Flagged in the standard's AKLA comments.

options.label: Required
options.hint: Keep Form F4 in template form

questions.title: Applicable environmental legislation
questions.question: Which environmental legislation applies?
questions.location: Site visit clause ("Applicable Laws (including applicable federal or provincial environmental legislation)"); Environmental and Social Matters clause
questions.basis: Flagged in the standard's AKLA comments.

options.label: The relevant provincial Environmental Protection Act
options.hint: Sindh / Punjab / KP / Balochistan — per the Project's location

options.label: Statutory regime plus the P3A ESMS
options.hint: P3A Environmental and Social Management System

questions.title: Land handover
questions.question: How will the Project Site be handed over?
questions.location: "Land Acquisition and Right of Way" clause
questions.basis: Flagged in the standard's AKLA comments.

options.label: Full vacant possession before Financial Close
Concessionaire-assisted acquisition, reimbursed by the Agency

questions.title: Resettlement Action Plan
questions.question: Is a Resettlement Action Plan required?
questions.location: "Land Acquisition and Right of Way" clause
questions.basis: Flagged in the standard's AKLA comments.

options.label: No — the site is vacant, unencumbered Government land

questions.title: Utility relocation cost
questions.question: Who bears the cost of relocating utilities?
questions.location: "Utility Relocation" clause ("confirmed in the Data Sheet: [●]")
questions.basis: Placeholder in the RFP.

questions.title: Source of KPIs and penalties
questions.question: Where will the KPIs and performance penalties be set out?
questions.location: "Key Performance Indicators" clause ("set out in the [O&M Manual / Service Level Agreement]")
questions.basis: Bracketed alternative in the RFP.

options.label: Service Level Agreement
options.hint: A schedule to the Concession Agreement

options.label: A KPI schedule in the Concession Agreement itself
